# VC-PW-5310

MEAN WELL is the manufacturer.
The company is Enterprises Co., Ltd.
The series is SDR-120.
The enclosure uses this outline for SDR-120-24.
The source file is `SDR-120-3D.zip`.
The source URL is https://www.meanwell.com/upload/pdf/SDR-120/SDR-120-3D.zip

- The archive contains `SDR-120/SDR-120.stp`.
- That STEP file is 14.7 MB.
- This repository does not store it.
- `SDR-120-exterior.step` keeps the four largest solids.
- Those solids are the case and the terminal parts.
- The outer box after `Rot(0, 0, -90)` is 40.0 x 126.26 x 128.96 mm.

That box is the full file outline.
The fifth solid does not change the outline.
It pushes the file above 10 MB.
Local X is the rail width.
Local Y is the depth.
The curved terminal cover is at positive Y.

- Local Z is the height.
- The vent grid is on the top face.
